stories.title: Claude Ship adds policy-controlled review, fixes and approvals
nodes:
PR Steward
Fix CI and feedback
stories.alt: Conceptual panel separating Claude Ship’s Code Review findings, PR Steward fixes, and Claude Approvals repository-policy checks. No performance claims are plotted.
stories.facts: Anthropic introduced Claude Ship in beta: Code Review is generally available, while PR Steward and Claude Approvals are beta tools for GitHub pull requests. Steward can work on fixes and feedback; Approvals evaluates requests against repository policy.
stories.inference: Begin with observe-only approval policies and independent tests before granting an AI reviewer authority in a MATLAB research repository.
stories.uncertainty: Vendor-announced capabilities, not independently verified reliability. PR Steward does not approve or merge requests; AI review can miss defects.

stories.title: New portfolio paper uses forecast calibration to gate costly trades
nodes:
Forecast vs neutral
Learn recent mixture
stories.alt: Conceptual mechanism panel showing a forecast compared with a neutral prediction, a calibrated cost-aware trading gate, and a payoff-weighted combination of gated experts.
stories.facts: A new preprint adjusts an adaptive moving-average forecast using predictive likelihoods against a neutral forecast, then feeds that calibrated mixture into a transaction-cost-aware portfolio rule. It also combines gated experts by payoff.
stories.inference: Test an explicit no-trade gate against a fixed cost threshold before making a trading agent more complex.
stories.uncertainty: Author-reported backtests, not independently replicated or live results. Historical proportional costs do not establish realistic spread, impact, latency or capacity performance.

stories.title: U.S. futures pull back after Monday’s rebound
stories.alt: Bar chart from a common zero of reported futures changes at 4:26 a.m. CST November 24: Dow E-mini minus 0.14%, S&P 500 E-mini minus 0.46%, Nasdaq-100 E-mini minus 1.11%. These are not ETF returns or live quotes.
stories.facts: Reuters reported Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 E-mini futures down 0.14%, 0.46% and 1.11%, respectively, at 5:26 a.m. Eastern after Monday’s rally.
stories.inference: Treat QQQ-sensitive opening gaps as execution risk; require fresh spread, size and depth evidence before increasing participation.
stories.uncertainty: A reported premarket snapshot, not live executable prices, SPY/QQQ returns or evidence of the cash-session outcome.

stories.title: Williams says inflation remains too high despite economic resilience
stories.credit: New York Fed, John C. Williams speech, Nov. 23
stories.alt: Conceptual panel summarizing Williams’s November 23 speech: a resilient economy and stable labor market, persistent inflation, and a policy path assessed against incoming data.
stories.facts: New York Fed President John Williams described resilient growth and a stable labor market, but said inflation remained too high and that restoring price stability required further work. He said his policy assessment would follow the totality of incoming data.
stories.inference: Stress rate-sensitive exposures against an inflation surprise rather than reading an equity rebound as confirmation of easier policy.
stories.uncertainty: One policymaker’s stated assessment, not a new FOMC decision, rate-path commitment or guarantee that inflation will follow his forecast.

stories.title: Best Buy raises its annual outlook ahead of holiday shopping
stories.date: Results released November 24, 2026; quarter ended October 31
stories.credit: Best Buy earnings release via Business Wire, Nov. 24
nodes:
Quarter ended Oct. 31
Comparable sales rose
stories.alt: Conceptual earnings panel distinguishing Best Buy’s reported quarter ended October 31 from its raised fiscal 2027 outlook and uncertain future holiday demand.
stories.facts: Best Buy reported third-quarter comparable sales growth of 6.1% and raised its fiscal 2027 comparable-sales growth guidance to 3.4%–4.0%. The release covers the quarter ended October 31.
stories.inference: Separate realized sales from forward guidance when testing consumer-electronics demand signals; monitor margin and holiday conversion alongside revenue.
stories.uncertainty: Company-reported results and management guidance. The holiday outcome is not yet realized, and this edition makes no claim about the stock’s reaction.
